summary: A table of records with search, add, edit and delete around it
purposes: add, edit and remove rows with a search

exposes.children.table.items: The records shown in the table: link it with <-items to an array in $.data; each record needs a key field (id by default)
exposes.children.table.columns: The columns, keyed by name: replace the map (null removes a column) and keep a delete button in a cell node that sets the table's selected to the row key and opens the confirm dialog
exposes.children.form.body.children: The fields of the add and edit form, keyed by the name that appears in the saved values: link each field's value to $.data
exposes.children.form._title: Title of the add and edit dialog
exposes.children.confirm._title: Title of the delete confirmation dialog
exposes.children.form.body.on: What saving does besides closing the dialog: add commands to submitted, or give the form an @id so the host is told of each submit with the values
exposes.children.confirm.footer.children.confirm: What deleting does besides closing the dialog: add commands to press that remove the selected record, or give the button an @id so the host is told
